# Ethan Allen Announces Preliminary Voting Results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_66f7465d09b95ecb7fba97a98b1b3ab2/ethanallen/news/2026-11-04_Ethan_Allen_Announces_Preliminary_Voting_Results_331.pdf) November 04, 2026 12:56pm EST


Preliminary Results Indicate Election of Two Company Nominees and Three DGB Nominees


DANBURY, CT, Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Ethan Allen Interiors Inc. (“Ethan Allen” or the “Company”) (NYSE: ETD), a leading interior design company, manufacturer and retailer in the home furnishings marketplace, today announced the preliminary voting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders (the “2026 Annual Meeting”). Based on the preliminary vote count provided by Georgeson LLC, the Company’s proxy solicitor, the Company believes stockholders have elected two of the Company’s five nominees, Maria Eugenia Casar and Tara I. Stacom, to the Company’s Board of Directors (the “Board”). Stockholders also appear to have elected three of the nominees proposed by DGB Investment, Inc. ("DGB"), Douglas G. Bergeron, Kristine Miller and Stephen Oblak.


Preliminary results also indicate that stockholders voted to approve the compensation of the Company’s named executive officers (say-on-pay proposal) and the ratification of CohnReznick LLP as the Company’s independent registered public accounting firm for the 2027 fiscal year.


The results announced today are preliminary and subject to certification by the independent inspector of elections. Final voting results will be disclosed in a Form 8-K filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission and posted on the Company’s investor relations website.


**About Ethan Allen**


Ethan Allen (NYSE: ETD) is a leading interior design destination combining state-of-the-art technology with personal service. Ethan Allen design centers, which represent a mix of Company-operated and independent licensee locations, offer complimentary interior design service and sell a full range of home furnishings, including custom furniture and artisan-crafted accents for every room in the home. Vertically integrated from product design through logistics, the Company manufactures about 75% of its custom-crafted furniture in its own North American manufacturing facilities and has been recognized for product quality and craftsmanship since 1932.
